question: Automobiles are fitted with a device that shows the distance travelled. Identify it.
solution:
The correct answer is **Odometer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **odometer** is an instrument used in vehicles to measure the distance travelled by the vehicle.
 
• It is typically located on the vehicle's dashboard.
 
• Odometers can be mechanical, digital, or a combination of both.
